authority_policy: Current official event deadlines and API scoring override explanatory articles; narrative edge cases are versioned overlays. Preserve conflicts.
fpl_access_scope: User-stated verified grant for required FPL scraping; other services have separate adapters.

sources.fields: all registered players, clubs, events, prices, scoring, chip periods
sources.units: integer GBP 0.1m; minutes; probabilities 0..1 after normalization

sources.fallback: last immutable snapshot; null-event fixtures remain unassigned

sources.fields: fixture-level official scoring, xG/xA, starts/minutes, defensive actions
sources.fallback: position priors, wider uncertainty and explicit missingness
dated structured import; never infer private future squad

sources.fields: partial public leaderboards; topProjected is not a full-market multiweek forecast
sources.fallback: independent component forecasts; missing comparator values stay missing

sources.provenance: Retrospective statistical archive; not proof of pre-deadline news/price availability

sources.fields: supporting source text and exact evidence spans
sources.fallback: manual supported evidence and dated official availability flags

sources.url: Gemini or Groq configured provider endpoints
sources.free: account-specific verification required; disabled by default
sources.fallback: structured human evidence; numerical engine remains operational
